check1_exact_duplicates.finding: Exact duplicate flow vectors exist in CIC-IDS2017 due to repetitive automated attack probes and persistent benign keep-alive sessions.

check2_near_duplicates.finding: Automated attack tools (hping, Slowloris, PortScan) generate flows with identical packet sizes, TCP flags, and window sizes.

check3_target_leakage.finding: Zero target labels, label-derived tokens, or direct proxies enter the feature matrix. Maximum correlation with target is reasonable.

check4_preprocessing_leakage.finding: RobustScaler was fitted strictly on X_train. Zero test distribution information leaked into scaler centers or scales.

check5_train_test_split.finding: Stratified train_test_split with fixed random_state=42 correctly implemented without index corruption or class dropping.

check6_class_distribution.finding: All 15 attack classes are preserved across both Train and Test sets in near-identical proportions.

check7_capture_session_correlation.finding: Random sampling across a monolithic PCAP capture allows flows from the same attack session to appear in both train and test. Destination Port holds significant Gini importance.
